step: mthbram (21) — the three lead lists are closed in production; the blocker that held the deploy contradicted the audit that wrote it
why_this_step: The previous heartbeat named #161 as the highest-value open debt and said it was blocked on order-of-operations: 'requireAdmin(has_role) and no account passes has_role today, so deploying before creating a real admin would lock the admin panel out of its own data' — which needs ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET, a NEEDS_USER item.

That blocker was checked instead of honoured, and it contradicts the audit that produced it. QA/mthbram/edge-functions-audit-0812/_results.json already recorded: 'nothing in the app calls them. AdminDashboard.tsx and MatchingTab.tsx read the lead tables through supabase.from(...) over PostgREST under the user session. Gating the three GETs therefore breaks no caller.'

Re-verified here, not taken on trust: the only reference to the api function anywhere in apps/21-mthbram outside node_modules/dist is src/components/admin/ApiReferenceSection.tsx, and every fetch( there is inside a template string printed as documentation — BASE_URL is only rendered and copied, never called. So there is no admin screen to lock out, and the bootstrap is not a precondition for the deploy.
The cost of waiting was not zero: until this deploy, every lead submitted from the web form, the chatbot or the IVR was readable by anyone who knew the URL.

before.request: GET with no apikey header and no Authorization header at all
before.reading: the open version was still the one running, three days after the fix was written at source. Tables still empty, so nothing has leaked.

change.source: no source change in this step — apps/21-mthbram/supabase/functions/api/index.ts already carried requireAdmin() from the earlier commit; this step is the deploy that was missing
change.how: Lovable send_message to project f53a4479-1aaf-45ee-810f-e8ea4ed3fbc2, one file replaced verbatim with the committed local source, agent then ran supabase deploy_edge_functions on 'api'
change.read_before_write: the Lovable copy of supabase/functions/api/index.ts was read first and was byte-for-byte the ungated version — confirming Lovable is what deploys this project, same evidence as #160

anon_key_as_bearer.note: the publishable key from apps/21-mthbram/.env, i.e. the exact token that ships in every page load
anon_key_as_bearer.reading: this is the leg verify_jwt could never have covered — the anon key is a valid JWT, and the gate rejects it because it carries no sub claim, so auth.getUser errors and requireAdmin returns 401

after.acceptance_test_from_needs_user: the test §0ק published for the user — 'the same GET with no headers must return 401 instead of 200, and GET /api/lessons must still return 200' — passes on both halves.

not_measured.signed_in_non_admin_403: attempted and not obtained. POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password for test@more30.com on this project returned 401 today (the same shape as #172 — an unconfirmed email is indistinguishable from a wrong password). The 403 branch was verified against this project's primitives during the audit on 12/08 (has_role(sub,'admin') -> False for that user) and its code is unchanged, but it is not re-verified against the deployed function here. Stated as a limit, not claimed as a pass.
not_measured.post_submission_routes: not exercised on purpose — every POST to /teachers, /seekers or /contacts inserts a real row into a live lead table. The code path is untouched by this change and the routes are absent from requireAdmin().

test_mode: no billing, no message sent, no account created, no row written. Protected systems (08, 09, bkalut-app, bkalot-admin, zr_*, NEDARIM3873) untouched; csj/csj_src/igud not used.

still_open.165: chat and search-lessons on the same project still spend LOVABLE_API_KEY with no caller check and no rate limit. Note that 21 has no customer login surface, so the gannenet answer (gate behind the account) would remove a public feature here — the fix has to be a per-caller rate limit, and that needs a store. Its own step.
still_open.167: egod seed-demo-portals — still blocked, its Lovable project refuses every message (NEEDS_USER §0יא).
still_open.admin_bootstrap: ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET is still needed before any human can call these three routes. That is now a convenience item, not a security blocker — it no longer gates anything the product uses.
